The vanir are titan-forged watchers fashioned from stone and with command over the powers of the earth. Under the guidance of Khaz'goroth, they were crafted from Azeroth's crust by the Pantheon themselves to be their hands and prosecute their will against the Black Empire. In their battles against the Old Gods, the enormous servants were accompanied by their sister-race - the aesir.
Vanndar Stormpike is a dwarf mountain king and the leader of the Stormpike Expedition in Alterac Valley. Vanndar rules from his fortress of Dun Baldar in the northern part of the Valley.
map.]] Vandermar Village was a Lordaeron village situated northeast of Lordamere Lake near Capital City. It was a large settlement, with its own church, cemetery and military garrison.
Vambraces of the Sadist are a pair of Level 42 quality Plate Bracers that improves Strength, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Var'jun is a jungle troll found in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Originally, he awaited level 10 priests, and told them where to go for their first racial ability.
Varos Cloudstrider is the second boss located in the Oculus. He is one of the Azure-Lords of the blue dragonflight and captain of the forces there.

Vampiric Blood is a Blood death knight ability that temporarily grants the death knight 30% of maximum health and increases the amount of health received through spells and effects by 30% for 10 sec. .]]
Vargul Slayers are vargul found in Thrym's End in Zul'Drak. Some are casting magic into Gymer.
Vargul Plaguetalons are undead eagles that can be found flying around Thrym's End in Zul'Drak.
Vampire Hunter is a Feat of Strength for killing Prince Tenris Mirkblood and looting Vampiric Batling from him. This boss was part of Zombie Infestation and was available only during this event.
Vana Grey is the flight master located at Amberpine Lodge in the contested territory of Grizzly Hills.

Var'dyn Skyseeker is a Highborne and apprentice to Archmage Mordent Evenshade. Though haughty, he respects Malfurion and others who are able to wield powerful forces. He is discontent with being unable to practice the arcane without restriction in Darnassus. Due to the limitations placed on the Highborne, he tries to lead a group of Highborne to practice their art in secret, though Malfurion catches him and reprimands him. He is also discontent with the Highborne being ostracized by the night elves, despite promises from Malfurion and Tyrande that they would be fully integrated into their society. When the Highborne were being killed off by an unknown assailant, Var'dyn was outraged. He even
Vamuu is a draenei located in the Chamber of Enlightenment in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
__NOTOC__ Valos Shadowrest is a night elf innkeeper located at the Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Vanaris Whitesong is a blood elf vendor located in the Chamber of Masters in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Vargrak was a chieftain of the in the days prior to Kilrogg Deadeye's rise to power. When Kilrogg allied himself with Durmak's spirit, along with those of Braknoth and Durmak chose to not assist them against the heroes of the Alliance and Horde.
The Vantus Rune Technique: Star Augur Etraeus is a reputation reward; you must be with The Wardens to purchase this item from Marin Bladewing in Azsuna for .
Various and Sundry is one of the four snails participating in the snail race in the Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain, along with Zoom, Helix for Brains and Glip Gloop Haberdasher.

Varoudnir is a large and very powerful grey-red wolfhawk found in the western most cave of the Eye of Azshara, along the southern coast. He is one of the three named wolfhawks, the other two being Kveldulfnir, and Mavarnir. Only hunters that know the secrets of taming feathermanes can capture him.

The Vampiric Felbat is a felbat held captive by the Illidari in the Tomb of the Penitent during the demon hunter starting experience in the Vault of the Wardens. During Grand Theft Felbat, it is used to fly from the Tomb of the Penitent and through the Fallen Passage to the Demon Ward in the upper portion of the Vault.
__NOTOC__ The Vanguard Battlemage is a draenei located in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City and an orc located in Pathfinder's Den in Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Vargul Runelords are vargul located in Thrym's End in Zul'Drak. Some are casting magic into Gymer.
The Varandi Family Crest drops from Enavra Varandi at the Moonlit Shore in .
Vandal's Zeal is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Varimathras' Shattered Manacles drop from Varimathras in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Vanguard's Momentum is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Vanguard's Momentum.
Vehena was a level 35 troll quest giver located in the Valley of Spirits in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.

.]] The Veiled Sea is the name of the vast sea that lies to the north and west of Kalimdor. It is the location of the former night elven homeland of Teldrassil, and the group of islands known as the Azuremyst Isles — where the draenei inter-planar vessel named The Exodar crash-landed. Giant turtles, sea turtles and krakens are known to live in the Veiled Sea. After the Great Sundering, both, portions of Zoram Strand and Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale sunk under the Veiled Sea. It is named after the fog that was raised by the night elves to shroud Kalimdor from outsiders until the Third War. Some time after the Cataclysm, a battle between the Wavestrider and the Inevitable occurred away from

during a flashback to the War of the Ancients in Legion.]] Vartrus the Ancient was a spirit of an Ancient of Lore located in the Irontree Woods in Felwood. The Ancient Petrified Leaf found in the Cache of the Firelord after Majordomo Executus' defeat belonged to him. Vartrus appears during the vision of the War of the Ancients where he defends the Azshara region along with Huln Highmountain.

The Vault (or the Stormwind Vault) is a prison within the human capital city of Stormwind. The Vault is located opposite the Stockade, and mirrors that other prison in most ways, except that the Vault is completely surrounded by water and has a clock on top of it. It is currently inaccessible, gated off by a portcullis with two guards.

The Vault of Ironforge is the main bank and treasure store in the city of Ironforge, located just across from the Auction House in the Commons district. Available to members of the Alliance, the bank's services are overseen by Dinita and the Stonemantle family.

Veil Skith is a colony of Skettis, capital of the arakkoa. It is located in Terokkar Forest directly south of Shattrath City, bordering the Bone Wastes. Veil Skith is the location of the Darkstone of Terokk.

Veil Rhaze is a colony of Skettis, the capital of the arakkoa. It is located to the west of the Refugee Caravan in the Bone Wastes, along the border with Terokkar Forest. Veil Rhaze was destroyed when Auchindoun exploded, the spirits of arakkoa slain in the explosion remained with Terokk's influence remaining on them. Torgos's Bane is located at 26,56.
Veiled Shadowsong Amethyst is crafted with Outland Jewelcrafting (75); taught by Design: Veiled Shadowsong Amethyst and Design: Veiled Shadowsong Amethyst#Shattered Sun Offensive.

Vashj'ir () is an underwater region located near the Eastern Kingdoms, off the western coast of Khaz Modan. The ruins of the city located in the Shimmering Expanse were the home of Lady Vashj before the Great Sundering. Players can swim throughout the zone by jumping but when on the ground it acts similar to the terrestrial zones and players can use special underwater mounts to move around it. In the Abyssal Depths is located the Abyssal Breach that allows you to reach the Abyssal Maw, which contains two 5-man dungeons. Unlike surface zones, the zones throughout Vashj'ir have no official night cycle. At night, Kelp'thar Forest, Shimmering Expanse and Abyssal Depths appear fully lit by some s
Vashj'ir Seahorse is a quest reward from The Abyssal Ride. She increases swimming speed by 450%, which results in speeds similar to flying mounts above land.

Vashj'ir is one of the two 80-82 level-up zones in Cataclysm. The zone itself is so large, however, that quests are tracked by each of Vashj'ir's subzones. Vashj'ir has a cohesive, overarching storyline that will span the length of the zone. The breadcrumb to Vashj'ir starts in either Stormwind or Orgrimmar, and is handed to adventurers the instant they step into the capital city. The breadcrumb will send adventurers on a perilous trek to Kelp'thar Forest, then progress to the Shimmering Expanse, then finally reach the Abyssal Depths. The progression of the storyline in Vashj'ir is tracked in the achievement Sinking into Vashj'ir. At the end of the Abyssal depths storyline, adventurers must
Vaultkeeper Shan is a pandaren located in the Celestial Vault in the Shrine of Seven Stars. She can be saved in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Vaultkeeper Silverpaw is a pandaren located at the bank in the Celestial Vault in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight as a corpse.
Vaultkeeper Melka is a draenei located in the Shrine of Seven Stars. She appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Vaultkeeper Fizznoggin is a gnome banker located in the Celestial Vault in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He can be saved in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Vaultkeeper Xifa is a pandaren banker in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Vaultkeeper Jiaku is a pandaren located in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Vaultkeeper Edouin is an ethereal void banker found in the Ethereal Corridor in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Vaultkeeper Meelad is an ethereal void banker found in the Hall of Secrets in the Shrine of Two Moons.
Vaultkeeper Shifen is a pandaren banker located in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Vaultkeeper Kan is a pandaren banker located in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Vaultkeeper Goldpenny is a goblin banker located in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

__NOTOC__ Varudis is a nathrezim that first appeared in the Black City during The Battle for Broken Shore (quest). He remained on the isle until the Armies of Legionfall invaded it, after which his status and whereabouts became unknown.
__NOTOC__ The Veiled Isles are the mist-covered small islands under Acherus: The Ebon Hold. The isles are mostly empty banks with the exception of Hell Shell.

The Veiled Den is one of the camps of the Illidari in the Antoran Wastes. This location may be destroyed. It alternates daily with Light's Purchase. The camp is occasionally attacked by Vile Thrashers and Fel Shriekers. A Lightforged beacon is there.
__NOTOC__ Vazun Starspeaker is a void elf located in Island Expeditions.
The Vault of Antiquities was a vast repository in Suramar where the Highborne stored artifacts of great power they had found, including the Pillars of Creation.

The Vault of Ice is where the Wardens have imprisoned Ash'golm, one of the most powerful of the prisoners within the Vault of the Wardens. During the Burning Legion invasion, demon hunters must reactivate the icy countermeasures that freeze him in place.
Vebinax is a fal'dorei located in Moonfall Retreat in Suramar. She and her spiders were encountered by champions of Class Orders.

Ve'rayn is a broker who briefly appears at the Ring of Transference in Oribos after players accept Explore Torghast, where she starts Trust Issues as part of the Torghast storyline. In patch 9.1, she appears in Korthia as part of the Pop Quiz vignette.
Vein Rippers is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Velgrim is an orc or human (depending on the race of the player) warrior that is a part of the Uber Town group. He can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple during Destiny Unfulfilled.
Velarok is a drake of the black dragonflight. His humanoid form is a human male named Velarok Windblade. Despite being described as "an ancient black dragon", Velarok uses a drake model.
Vault of Heavens is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Heavenly Vault.

The Veiled Enclave is a rarely-used building nestled beneath a hill south of the Eternal Forge in Bastion. Long ago, agents of Revendreth concealed a transport mirror within the Veiled Enclave, for operations in Denathrius's name. Some dead Enclave Watchers and wildlife can be found here, seemingly killed by the mirror's magic. The inner portion of the enclave is blocked off by a closed door.
Velania's Walking Stick is a quest reward from Arcane Instability (quest).
__NOTOC__ Velora Nitely is a Forsaken located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. It is said that in life she was one of the finest blacksmiths of Lordaeron.
__NOTOC__ The Vengeful Ancient was a rare mob treant found roaming the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains. It was on a 5-8 hour respawn timer.

]] Venom spiders are a type of spiders. They are the size of a human. Its multiple eyes glitter with cunning, and a viscous fluid coats its mandibles. Long ago, Elwynn Forest was populated with a group of spiders that lived peacefully amid the woods. Yet when the curse fell over Duskwood and turned the once peaceful woodland into a realm of terror, the spiders began to mutate and grow to monstrous proportions. Now, the lurking venom spiders hunt their hapless prey in all of the shadowed corners of the land. Possessing both deadly acidic venom and powerful webbing, these cruel beasts stalk any foolish wanderers who stray too far into the haunted woods.

Vengeance Landing is the military outpost for the Hand of Vengeance, located northeast of Daggercap Bay and Utgarde Keep. It is the Horde port in the Howling Fjord, a place entirely built and run by the Forsaken under the direction of Sylvanas Windrunner. As the Horde's main point of arrival in eastern Northrend, they've got their own docks, taking in ships from Tirisfal Glades, and a zeppelin tower which ensured the passage with the other outside of Undercity. The whole town looks sickly, even from a distance, a yellow pall hanging over the vale around it. The Alliance ambushed Vengeance Landing, having established a small camp outside its walls. The Horde soldiers were not making any progr
The Vengeful Gladiator's Bonecracker is sold by Kitzie Crankshot for 5 Mark of Honor. This item was a PvP reward, and could be purchased for from in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Venom Web Spray is one of the pet abilities that only silithid can use. It roots an enemy for 4 seconds.
Veneratus the Many is an observer located at Illidari Point in Shadowmoon Valley.
Velia Moonbow is a night elf guild vendor located in Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was caught in the chaos and could be saved.
Venomfang Crocolisks are crocolisks found in Lost City of the Tol'vir.
Venomguard Destroyers are jungle trolls in slith form found in the Coil in Zul'Gurub.
Vengeful Retreat is a demon hunter ability. It is automatically learned for havoc demon hunters.
Velimar is an void terror located at the Jeweled Estate in the Court of Stars.

Venomfang Spiderling are spiders located in the Forgotten Caves in Gorgrond where they hatch from Spider Egg Sacs. They are also found in the Forge of Aeons where they hatch from Spider Egg Sacs. They apply a stacking poison called Creeping Visions. 10 stacks will cause the adventurer to go insane and see Hallucinations attack them. They are also found in Island Expeditions.
Vengeful Protectors are ancient protectors located in Shatterspear Vale Darkshore.

__NOTOC__ Vengeful Huntresses were night elves fighting the Horde in Lor'danel and Mist's Edge in Darkshore after the Burning of Teldrassil. Some of them were seen repairing broken glaive throwers while others were wounded and being treated by Priestesses of the Moon.
The Vend-O-Matic Mk. V is a vending machine located in Island Expeditions.
Venomancer Ant'su is a jungle troll venomancer located in Island Expeditions.
Venombulb is a spitter located in Verdant Wilds in Island Expeditions.
Vengeance's Reins teaches Vengeance, a dragonhawk flying mount that drops from Sylvanas Windrunner on Mythic mode difficulty only, the final boss of the Sanctum of Domination.
Velvety Stalker Hide drops from Moonwhisper Stalker in Suramar.

The Venture Company or Venture Trading Company, often shortened to simply Venture Co., is a goblin-run cartel notorious for plundering Azeroth's natural resources. Considered part of the Trade Coalition, the company operates throughout many parts of Azeroth, including Mulgore, the Barrens, the Stonetalon Mountains, and Azuremyst Isle in Kalimdor, Stranglethorn Vale in the Eastern Kingdoms, and Sholazar Basin and the Grizzly Hills in Northrend. During the Fourth War, the organization took control of the MOTHERLODE!! on Kezan. In addition to being known for their ruthless methods, the company has historically had dealings with various destructive organizations, including the Defias Brotherhood

Verigan's Fist was a two-handed mace. It gave bonuses to stamina, intellect, and spirit. The mace could be crafted by Jordan Stilwell, a blacksmith that formerly lived in Shadowfang Keep. Jordan required high-quality Whitestone Oak Lumber, a shipment of refined ore, his enchanted smithing hammer and a Purified Kor Gem for the job. Since the mace was imbued with the power of the Holy Light, Stilwell named it after Bosch Verigan, a late dwarven paladin friend of his.

Verner Osgood was a human located in front of the Lakeshire smithy in the Redridge Mountains. He was the resident blacksmith and was trying to make shoes for his horses. Unfortunately, a large amount of his iron went toward keeping the Stormwind Guard equipped, and the local gnolls made his job even harder by taking his horses when they strayed. Verner wanted the gnolls dead, along with their leader, Yowler. He died from his wounds after warning Magistrate Solomon of an attack on Lakeshire by the Scourge.

Vernon Hale is a human fishing and fish vendor located in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. He had to repair his fishing boat after it sprang a leak. He was friends with Ben Howell before the latter died.

__NOTOC__ The Venture Co. Mine (also spelled Venture Company Mine) is an enormous mine run by the Venture Company in the eastern cliffs of Mulgore. The savage defilement of the ancient mountains is greatly upsetting to the tauren of Bloodhoof Village, who seek to eradicate the goblins from the land. A caravan was supposed to bring new supplies to the mine however it was raided by tauren.
__NOTOC__ Venture Co. Loggers are found in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Veridian Point is the northern tip of Wyrmscar Island which is located to the northeast of Bloodmyst Isle. It is infested with dragon whelps.
Verek's Collar is a Level 51 quality Necklace that improves Strength, Stamina and Dodge.
__NOTOC__ Veras Darkshadow is a blood elf boss in the Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley. He is the rogue classed member of the Illidari Council. He specializes in assassination.
The Venture Co. Engineering Plans are located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Venture Co. Letters is contained in Venture Co. Documents in Stonetalon Mountains. This item is provided for Kaela's Update.
Venture Co. Operators are found in Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains.
The Venture Co. Documents is located in Stonetalon Mountains.

Venomspite is a Forsaken town in eastern Dragonblight. Here, the Hand of Vengeance are continuing their plague experiments, and Horde players are sent here by a special flight path that requires you to have finished the primary quest chains at New Agamand in Howling Fjord. To the north lies the equivalent questing hub of the Alliance called Wintergarde Keep. Venomspite has the same typical architecture found within Vengeance Landing and other Forsaken outposts in the Howling Fjord.
The Verdant Torch is provided as an objective for the following quests: * Destroy the Sapling * Vordrassil's Sapling
__NOTOC__ Venture Co. Deforesters are found in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Veridian Whelps are undead green whelps that can be found at Wyrmscar Island in Bloodmyst Isle.
Vernal the Fixer is a goblin vendor located at the Fold in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Venomshade is found in the center of Blademoon Bloom in the southeast portion of . It drops Venomshade Skin Boots and 10-20x Garrison Resources.

The Venture Co. Tower is an old tower in Northern Barrens just north of the Sludge Fen, owned by the Venture Company. It is unknown if the tower was built by the Venture Company of if it was built during a previous campaign by the Horde. The Shattered Hand was previously scouting this tower for some time and sometimes covertly sought help from adventurous rogues to sneak in and gather intelligence. Due to the fumes of the various Zanzil poisons stored here, the inhabitants of the tower were especially weak to sneak attacks.
Venture Co. Engineers are goblins and humans located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Venture Co. Holdouts are Dark Iron dwarves, humans, and goblins located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Venomshiv's Secret Formula drops from Gardul Venomshiv at the Shattered Rise in Spires of Arak.
Venture Co. Skyscorchers are goblins located in Shadowforge City in Blackrock Depths during Blackrock Depths (quest).
Venture Co. Builders are goblins, humans, gnolls, and Dark Iron dwarves located in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Venture Co. Machine Smiths are goblins and humans located in the Stonetalon Mountains. They summon Compact Harvest Reapers.
Venture Muscles are hobgoblins located on the expedition islands.
Venture Co. Transport is a hot air balloon located on Mechagon Island.
Venture Co. Rocket Box drops from the following Venture Company members on Mechagon Island: *Share Stealer Wonka *Profit Maker Grifa *Problem Solver Skitz *Lifting Specialist Gogo
Vera Lonelycog is a Mechagon mechagnome located on Mechagon Island.
Venture Overseers are goblins and gnomes who briefly appear at Waterspring Field in Tanaris.
Venture Salvagers are goblins who briefly appear at Waterspring Field in Tanaris.
The Venthyr Concordat drops from mobs in the Maw with higher chance from more powerful enemies.
Venthyr's Gratitude is an anima power obtained from a Prisoner's Anima in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Venomshade Skin Boots drop from Venomshade in Blademoon Bloom in .
Venomreaver is a wind serpent located in Island Expeditions.
Venomswell is a water elemental located in Island Expeditions.
Venture Acquisitions Specialist is a goblin located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Venture Middle Manager is a goblin located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Venture Producer is a goblin located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Venture Sub-Lead is a goblin located in Island Expeditions.

Taking part are Lady Moonberry, Prince Renathal, General Draven, The Curator, Temel, Cryptkeeper Kassir, The Accuser, Gresit, Rendle, Cudgelface, Nadjia the Mistblade, Tubbins, Gubbins, Theotar, Niya, Hunt-Captain Korayn, Boot the Beaut, Stonehead, Clumpdump, Burly Hurly, and Muckhands. Verdant Infusion is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Verdant Infusion.

__NOTOC__ Veritistrasz is a red dragon in a dwarf form located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. He used to have many friends in the black dragonflight, including one he loved, but their betrayal and the events of the Dragon Wars ended it all. After his best friend slew his family, Veritistrasz killed her himself, and has been regretting it ever since.
__NOTOC__ Verdant Skitterfly has a chance to drop from Expedition Scout's Packs which unlocks after reaching 25 Renown with the Dragonscale Expedition.
Verdant Combatant is a feat of strength achievement earned by...

Verdant Legend's Pennant is an achievement reward from Legend: Dragonflight Season 3.
__NOTOC__ Veridian Broodlings are undead green whelps that can be found at Wyrmscar Island in Bloodmyst Isle.
Vhan is a tauren located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.
The Vial of Blessed Water is obtained by using Eridan's Vial at the waters of the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

The Verrall Delta in the Twilight Highlands is where the water from the Verrall River runs out into the ocean. The area is home to many crazed hostile water elementals that drop Whirlpool Cores for Any Portal in a Storm and Muddied Waters. It also contains piles of :Verrall River Muck requested in The Perfect Poultice and Cementing Our Victory. Dragonmaw Port is located in a small peninsula at the eastern end of the delta.
Veteran of the Shifting Sands is a Feat of Strength achievement granted for completing the quests leading up to the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
Vestments of the Shattered Vale is the tier 16 restoration druid set.

__NOTOC__ Vess-Guard Na'kal is a mantid found at the Clutches of Shek'zeer in the Dread Wastes. He is a champion of the mantid loyal to the empress, but his strength comes not from talent or experience, but rather genetic modifications, an honor normally reserved for veteran soldiers.

Vethir is a storm drake located in Stormheim. He fights the player in Signal Boost before flying off, and later reveals himself to be the de facto leader of the Thorignir. During the Legion Assaults, he and an adventurer attacked Shield's Rest, which had been overrun by the Burning Legion. He was injured during the assault.

Vhell is a Forsaken or dwarf (depending on the race of the player) rogue that is a part of the Uber Town group. He can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.

__NOTOC__ Verstok Darkbough is a night elf druid of the Ashen located in Val'sharah. He first appears at Ashamane's Gate where he implored his master Delandros Shimmermoon to take immediate action. Delandros refuses and wants to protect his druids first, so Verstok rushes off to Ashamane's Fall to protect the Fangs of Ashamane. Once the demon threat is averted from Mistvale, the druid adventurer enters the Fall as Verstok grabs the Fangs and escapes, denying Algromon his prize. After the pit lord's death, Delandros sent the hero to track down Verstok and the Fangs. Veteran Vindicators were Aldor draenei located in Terrace of Light before the formation of the Shattered Sun Offensive.

Vessel Iluna is a Zandalari troll located in the Lost Spirit Lounge in Dazar'alor. When the traitorous prophet Zul and Mythrax attacked the city, Iluna was cornered by the invading sethrak. She was rescued by the Speaker of the Horde and joined the fight alongside Princess Talanji. She was present when riots erupted in the Zocalo during Talanji's coronation.

Vessel Zetoa is a Zandalari troll located in the Lost Spirit Lounge in Dazar'alor. When the traitorous prophet Zul and Mythrax attacked the city, Zetoa was cornered by the invading sethrak. She was rescued by the Speaker of the Horde and joined the fight alongside Princess Talanji. She was present when riots erupted in the Zocalo during Talanji's coronation.

In the aftermath of the insurrection and Elisande's eventual defeat, Victoire was appointed First Blade of the Duskwatch under the new regime of First Arcanist Thalyssra.

The Violet Eye is a secret sect founded by the Kirin Tor of Dalaran; they were assigned to keep an eye on Karazhan and to spy on the Guardian of Tirisfal Medivh and his works. Although Medivh was dead for decades, and Karazhan believed to be sealed itself off to the outside world, the Violet Eye remained to study the tower and the effects of its magic disturbances on Deadwind Pass. As Karazhan is a portal into Twisting Nether, a beacon shining into other worlds, it is the Violet Eye's mission to ensure that the tower don't fall into the wrong hands, or the possible repercussions would be unthinkable. The Violet Hold is a prison located in Dalaran. It is the third instance to be located within the bounds of a capital city (after the Stormwind Stockade and Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm). The quest Discretion is Key (Violet Hold), obtained from Rhonin at level 75, introduces the player to the dungeon.

Villagers lived in Lordaeron's various villages, and many of them were helped by Arthas during his campaign against the Blackrock clan and the Scourge. Arthas massacred many of them in Stratholme because they were infected by the Plague of Undeath. Then Arthas became the Scourge champion and started killing many inocent villagers. With the arrival of the Burning Legion, many more of them were killed. After the Third War, many still survived as the last surviving villagers of Lordaeron intended to leave to the recently retaken city of Dalaran, however, Arthas killed them all before they could escape. Some who escaped with Jaina Proudmoore's Human Expedition later were seen in Theramore Isle.

Vinvo Goldgear was an elite level 85 Strand of the Ancients battlemaster located in Shattrath's Lower City during the Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients. He was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients).

The Viletongue tribe of saurok that attack Thunderpaw Overlook and Thunderpaw Refuge in The Jade Forest during A Brewing Storm. Vindicator Iruun is a draenei ghost that appears at the Congregation of Souls in Auchindoun while fighting Teron'gor. She had a burning hatred for demons and battled them in life, but Teron'gor corrupts her spirit to gain powers of Demonology.

Vilewing Ambushers are Vilewing harpies that spawn in waves during the Scout Harefoot vignette on the Heymanhoof Slope in Highmountain. There are two waves, consisting of three ambushers each, and after fending off both, Mynta Talonscreech appears.

__NOTOC__ Vintner Iltheux is a nightborne located in the Twilight Vineyards within Suramar City in Suramar. He instructs volunteers on how to make arcwine the correct way to help ensure that the vineyard meets its quota.

The Vindicaar (pronounced VIN-di-kar) is a space-faring vessel, similar in design to the naaru dimensional ships, created by the draenei of the Exodar in order to return to their homeworld of Argus. The vessel would go on to take part in the Argus Campaign against the Burning Legion, in which it acted as headquarters for the mortal forces. The ship can maintain instant connections to various nearby and distant locations at a given time through the use of Lightforged beacons. The Vindicaar is also equipped with powerful defensive shields, as well as offensive air-to-surface weaponry.
